The Tigers, led by third year head coach [[Pat Skerry]], played their home games at the brand new [[SECU Arena]] and were members of the [[Colonial Athletic Association]]. They finished the season 25–11, 13–3 in CAA play to finish in second place. They advanced to the semifinals of the [[2014 CAA men's basketball tournament|CAA tournament]] where they lost to William & Mary.
